mLocKeys.keySummary: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Hitting a target with any of Ezreal's abilities increases his <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> by 10% for 5 seconds (effect stacks up to 5 times).
This unit has decreased Attack Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt at the nearest enemy unit, dealing <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ezreal fires a bolt of energy, dealing @Damage@ physical damage (applies on-hit effects).

Ezreal's cooldowns are reduced by 1 second if Mystic Shot hits a target.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ezreal channels for 1 second to fire a powerful barrage of energy missiles which do massive damage to each unit they pass through (deals 10% less damage to each unit it passes through).
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ezreal channels for 1 second to fire a barrage of missiles dealing <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to each unit it passes through. However, it deals @DamageReductionPerHit*100@% less damage for each unit it hits (minimum @MinimumDamagePercent*100@%)
This unit has increased Attack Speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ezreal fires a fluctuating wave of energy, decreasing the Attack Speed and dealing magic damage to enemy champions, while healing and increasing the Attack Speed of allied champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Ezreal fires a wave of energy that damages all enemy champions it passes through for @Damage@ magic damage and reducing their Attack Speed by @AttackSpeed@% for 5 seconds.

Allied champions hit by the wave restore @TotalHeal@ Health and have their Attack Speed increased by @AttackSpeed@% for 5 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Essence Flux can hit Ezreal in addition to his allies</rules>
